agemax.description: Period after which an entry in the database should be removed.

home.description: Defines where the home directory is.

lockdekay.description: The delay in seconds between two locking attempts.

lockhold.description: The maximum delay in seconds for holding a lock.

lockmax.description: Maximum number of locking attempts before giving up.

lockwarn.description: Time after which to start emitting warnings when busy trying to acquire a lock.

mailopt.description: Options to be passed to the mailer.

maxcmds.description: Maximum number of commands allowed to be executed by a SERVER command.

maxerrors.description: Maximum number of errors for the SERVER command before flushing.

maxsize.description: Maximum size in bytes of files before using kit for sending files.

mhprofile.description: The name of the MH profile to be used.

mmdf.description: Set this to ON if you wish to be able to save mail in MMDF-style mailboxes.

mmdfbox.description: If set to ON, new folders will be created as MMDF ones.

msgprefix.description: Name of the file to put in directory folders, specifying the message prefix.

newcmd.description: Name of the file describing new filtering commands.

newsopt.description: Options to be passed to the news posting program.

nfslock.description: Set it to ON to ensure NFS-secure locks.

path.description: Minimum path to be used by C filter program.

plsave.description: Name of the file used to save the patchlevels for archived distributions.

powerdir.description: Directory listing user clearances for SERVER powers.

powerlog.description: File where SERVER power requests are logged.

proglist.description: A small description for the available distributions.

queuelost.description: Maximum number of seconds after which mailagent should flag messages as old.

queuewait.description: Time in seconds telling the C filter program how long it must wait before launching mailagent.

rulecache.description: Name of the file used to cache the latest compiled rules.

rulemac.description: Set this to ON to enable macro substitutions in rule patterns.

rules.description: The name of the file holding the filtering rules.

runmax.description: Timeout for RUN commands and friends.

secure.description: When set to ON, mailagent performs extensive security checks.

sendmail.description: The name of the program used to send mail.

sendnews.description: The name of the program used to post news.

seq.description: File used to compute job numbers.

servdir.description: Directory name where shell and perl server commands are stored.

timezone.description: The time zone value for environment variable TZ.

tofake.description: Whether to fake a To: line into the message header.

tome.description: A comma separated list of alternate logins that are also valid for the user (mail aliases). In the config file, this is a single string, but we map to list for schema clarity, rendered as comma-separated string in template if needed. Note: The man page says 'comma separated list'. The template will render the list joined by commas if it were a list of strings, but here we use a single string for simplicity in the template unless specific list handling is required. However, to adhere strictly to 'list' type in schema, we will join it in the template logic if it is a list. Wait, the template uses {{ tome }}. If tome is a list, it needs join. Let's make tome a string in template to avoid complexity, or use join. Let's use join for safety if it's a list. Actually, the man page says 'comma separated list'. I will treat it as a string in the schema to match the config file format directly, as splitting/joining in Jinja2 for a simple config value is overkill and prone to error if not handled perfectly. Re-reading: 'values_schema... type is EXACTLY one of string|number|bool|list'. If I make it a list, I must use join in template. If I make it a string, it's simpler. I will make it a string for simplicity as it is a single directive value.

user.description: Login name of the user who runs mailagent.

vacation.description: Set to ON to switch the vacation mode.

vacfile.description: The name of the file to be sent back in vacation mode.

vacfixed.description: When ON, all changes to the vacation file are forbidden.

vacperiod.description: The minimum time elapsed between two vacation messages.
